SELECT id, stocktake_id, household_id, lot_id, location_id, book_quantity, actual_quantity, position_revision, reason FROM inventory_stocktake_item WHERE household_id = #{householdId} AND stocktake_id = #{stocktakeId} ORDER BY id

SELECT sti.id, sti.lot_id AS "lotId", sti.location_id AS "locationId", sti.book_quantity AS "bookQuantity", sti.actual_quantity AS "actualQuantity", sti.position_revision AS "positionRevision", sti.reason, i.name AS "itemName", l.lot_number AS "lotNumber", u.name AS "unitName" FROM inventory_stocktake_item sti JOIN inventory_lot l ON l.id = sti.lot_id JOIN catalog_item i ON i.id = l.item_id JOIN catalog_unit u ON u.id = i.unit_id WHERE sti.household_id = #{householdId} AND sti.stocktake_id = #{stocktakeId} ORDER BY sti.id
